headline: Small team. Big fries. Bigger games.
tagline: We're Wi-Fry Studios — a group of creators building fun, memorable Roblox experiences. We experiment, make cool stuff, and try not to burn the fries.
about: Wi-Fry Studios is a Roblox development group focused on making games people actually want to come back to. We like trying new ideas, building together, and improving every release. We're a small team, so every bit of feedback and support matters.
